description: This file defines the MessageParam class, which models a parameter used in messaging within a communication system. It encapsulates logic for initializing parameters based on various data types (boolean, custom reference, date, number, string), and provides methods for retrieving and representing the parameter in native code declarations.

classes.name: MessageParam
classes.description: Represents an input or output parameter for a message, capable of initializing its type based on various attribute flags in the provided ICMessageParm bean, and generating native code declarations.

methods.name: MessageParam
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parameter's type based on the properties set in the ICMessageParm bean.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the underlying variable representing the parameter.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the parameter.

methods.name: getNativeDeclaration
methods.description: Generates a C language variable declaration string for this parameter, suitable for use with malloc or other memory management.
